company.shortDescription: Makeasite provides an AI-driven platform for creating and launching SaaS websites from natural language prompts.
company.description: Makeasite provides an AI-driven platform that helps users create and launch SaaS websites from natural language prompts. The service offers a functional Next.js SaaS template with preconfigured integrations such as Supabase, PostHog, Stripe, and Google authentication. Users can generate site structure and content, then share the resulting website with a single click. Makeasite also includes an AI assistant that can edit project files, generate and update code, and manage database migrations and queries through chat. The assistant helps debug issues by surfacing frontend errors and tracing problems without manual log inspection. It supports searching across the codebase, pulling in external web context, and tracking changes with built-in versioning and rollback. The platform is intended for developers and product builders who want to focus on application logic rather than boilerplate infrastructure.
